verdict.rationale: Column exposes a full REST API (with OpenAPI spec for SDK generation) covering accounts, unified transfer/transaction queries, statements, raw wire message data, checks, and CSV/JSON/Parquet reports — a clean programmatic surface rather than dashboard scraping. However, there is no evidence of an MCP server/tool surface, and 'pending activity' isn't explicitly modeled (only holds/transfer states) as a first-class read endpoint for agents. missing for 10: MCP server or agent-specific tool endpoint, explicit pending-transaction feed, independent confirmation of agent usage.
